guard: A workflow driver has no cross-run broker authority. Host operations check the current journal, reject copied foreign tokens and forged receipts, and preserve parent-owned cancellation cleanup.

mutations.name: raw driver gains a stream-wide records read
mutations.expectRed: run A cannot read run B's program through its records connection
mutations.cell: run A cannot read run B's program through its records connection

mutations.name: raw driver gains endpoint-wide checkpoint writes
mutations.expectRed: run A cannot update another run's checkpoint key
mutations.cell: run A cannot update another run's checkpoint key

mutations.name: raw driver gains every chat consumer delete
mutations.expectRed: run A cannot delete run B's wait durable
mutations.cell: run A cannot delete run B's wait durable

mutations.name: a copied foreign token is accepted as owned
mutations.expectRed: copying a foreign token into the driver's own journal grants no host access
mutations.cell: copying a foreign token into the driver's own journal grants no host access

mutations.name: parent cancellation obligations are ignored
mutations.expectRed: a settled race parent authorizes cleanup of its settled losing sleep
mutations.cell: a settled race parent authorizes cleanup of its settled losing sleep

mutations.name: a settled wait can be reopened
mutations.find:
if (operation === "close" && cleaning) return entry;
      if (entry.state === "pending" && !cleaning) return entry;
mutations.replace:
if (operation === "close" && cleaning) return entry;
      if (!cleaning) return entry;
mutations.expectRed: a settled wait cannot be opened again through the host
mutations.cell: a settled wait cannot be opened again through the host

mutations.name: an invented receipt can use the first held delivery
mutations.expectRed: a serialized copy of a receipt cannot acknowledge a delivery
mutations.cell: a serialized copy of a receipt cannot acknowledge a delivery

mutations.name: the record host accepts another run key
mutations.find: if (!own(key) || /[*>]/.test(key)) throw new RunScopeDenied(run, key, "read record");
mutations.replace: if (/[*>]/.test(key)) throw new RunScopeDenied(run, key, "read record");
mutations.expectRed: the record host refuses another run's existing program
mutations.cell: the record host refuses another run's existing program

mutations.name: a forged conclave plan bypasses source-bound channel ownership
mutations.expectRed: the host rejects forged ownership of an existing channel
mutations.cell: the host rejects forged ownership of an existing channel

mutations.name: the single-credential refusal drops its remedy
mutations.find: From the project with the recorded static-auth mesh and signer, omit --creds and run cotal run start --local --space <space> --file <program>. If you only have caller credentials, ask the mesh operator to host the run.
mutations.expectRed: the local credential refusal gives a concrete next command
mutations.cell: the local credential refusal gives a concrete next command

mutations.name: settled parent history is rejected during child adoption
mutations.expectRed: a forked child resumes through the host with its inherited settled prefix
mutations.cell: a forked child resumes through the host with its inherited settled prefix
